text: Descriptor paths shall be relative to the containing descriptor, use `/`, and reject absolute paths, backslashes, empty components, `.`/`..`, and symlink escapes. Descriptor digests shall cover canonical JSON; blob/segment digests shall cover exact bytes. Section sizes/positions shall be unsigned u32.
